note: griddled onions, pickles and a slice of American

dish.make_ahead: Shape the patties up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Divide the mince into four loose balls and slice the onion very thin.
Heat a griddle until very hot. Put the beef balls on it, top with onion and press firmly into thin patties. Season with salt and pepper.
Cook 3 minutes, flip and cook a further 2 to 3 minutes until the centre reaches 75C. Lay the cheese on top to melt.
Toast the buns and fill with the patties, pickles and mustard.

note: eggs, bacon and toast, ideally not cooked by a robot arm

steps.text: Lay the bacon in a cold frying pan and cook over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until crisp. Lift out onto a plate.
Fry the eggs in the bacon fat, spooning the fat over the yolks until the whites are set.
Meanwhile toast the white bread and spread with the butter.
Plate the eggs with the bacon and buttered toast.

note: Panko chicken under ham, tomato sauce and mozzarella, with fries and salad

dish.n: Prom night chicken parmesan and fries
dish.make_ahead: Crumb up to 4 hours ahead, keep chilled

ingredients.item: chicken breasts, halved through the middle

steps.text: Crumb the chicken in flour, egg then panko. Soak the cut chips in cold water, then dry well.
Fry the chips at a low heat until soft, drain, then fry again at a high heat until golden.
Shallow fry the chicken until golden and cooked through.
Top each piece with napoli sauce, ham and mozzarella and grill until bubbling. Serve with the chips and salad.

note: Foil-baked paprika pork ribs finished over coals, with crunchy cabbage slaw

steps.text: Rub the ribs with paprika, brown sugar, garlic powder, cayenne and salt.
Wrap the ribs in foil.
Bake at 150C until tender.
Shred the cabbage and carrot and toss with mayonnaise for a crunchy coleslaw.
Unwrap the ribs, brush with barbecue sauce and finish over hot coals until sticky.

note: McClane hasn't slept in days

dish.n: Bacon egg and cheese on a roll
dish.make_ahead: Best eaten straight away

steps.text: Fry the bacon until crisp.
Fry the eggs in the same pan, breaking the yolks, and lay a slice of cheese on each to melt.
Split, butter and toast the rolls. Fill with bacon and egg, season and add tomato sauce.

film: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai (1999)
note: Ghost Dog's rooftop

dish.make_ahead: Best eaten straight away

steps.text: Cook the rice and keep warm.
Simmer the soy, mirin, sake and sugar until syrupy.
Sear the chicken skin side down, flip and cook through, then pour in the sauce and turn until glazed.
Slice the chicken over the rice and top with pickled ginger and spring onion.

note: Two smashed patties with onion, pickles, mustard and ketchup on a toasted bun

steps.text: Roll the mince into eight balls and dice the onion.
Smash each flat on a smoking griddle, season and cook.
Flip, top with cheese and cook a minute more. Toast the buns.
Stack two per bun with onion, pickles, mustard and tomato sauce.

note: Garlic and rosemary lamb leg with roast potatoes and homemade mint sauce

steps.text: Stud the lamb with garlic and rosemary, rub with oil and salt
Roast at 180C until 58C inside, with the potatoes alongside
Rest
Mix the mint with sugar, vinegar and boiling water for mint sauce
Carve and serve

note: Lamb and carrot pie in Worcestershire gravy under mashed potato

dish.make_ahead: Assemble up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Brown the lamb mince, then add the diced onion and carrots.
Stir in the tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce and stock and simmer until thick.
Boil the potatoes, mash with most of the butter and the milk.
Tip the filling into a baking dish, spread the mash over and rough up the top with a fork.
Bake at 200C until golden.
Toss the peas with the last of the butter and serve.

note: Chicken thighs simmered in onion gravy, over rice with garlicky kale

steps.text: Flour the chicken and brown in batches.
Make a dark roux in the pan with butter and flour.
Add the sliced onions and stock.
Simmer the chicken in the gravy.
Cook the rice and braise the kale with garlic.
Serve the chicken and gravy over the rice with the kale.

note: Yogurt and spice marinated chicken in flatbread with garlic sauce and pickled turnips

dish.make_ahead: Marinate overnight

steps.text: Mix the chicken with the yoghurt, garlic, spices and lemon juice. Marinate overnight in the fridge.
Grill the chicken until cooked through and charred.
Rest and slice.
Warm the flatbreads and fill with chicken, garlic sauce, pickled turnips, tomato and parsley.

note: Dry-brined sirloin basted in butter and thyme, red wine pan sauce

dish.make_ahead: Dry-brine the day before

steps.text: Salt the steaks and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight.
Sear hard in a hot pan.
Baste with part of the butter and thyme for a minute, then rest the steaks.
Add the wine and stock to the pan and reduce by half, then whisk in the rest of the butter.
Slice the steak and pour over the sauce.

note: prime rib at the club

dish.make_ahead: Salt the roast the day before

steps.text: Salt the roast the day before and leave it uncovered in the fridge.
Roast at 120C until 52C inside.
Rest the beef.
Roast the potatoes in oil at 200C while the beef rests.
Blast the beef at 260C for a crust.
Simmer the pan juices with the stock for jus.
Carve and serve with horseradish cream, potatoes and jus.

note: Lemon chilli grilled chicken, chapati and tomato kachumbari salad

steps.text: Marinate the chicken with the lemon juice, garlic, chilli flakes, paprika, some of the oil and salt.
Marinate in the fridge.
Mix the flour, salt, remaining oil and warm water into a dough, knead, then rest.
Roll the dough into rounds and dry-fry each side in a hot pan.
Grill the chicken, turning once, until cooked through.
Toss the tomatoes, onion, coriander and lime juice for the kachumbari and serve with the chicken and chapati.

note: Seared pork chops roasted with apples and onions, mashed potatoes, braised cabbage

steps.text: Sear the pork chops until golden.
Add the apples and onions to the pan and roast at 200C.
Boil the potatoes and mash with butter.
Braise the cabbage in a little butter and water until soft.
Serve it all on big plates.

note: Fried flour tortillas packed with chipotle beef, black beans and cheddar

dish.make_ahead: Filling up to 2 days ahead, fry to serve

steps.text: Braise the beef with the onion, chipotles and cumin until falling apart.
Shred the beef.
Fill the tortillas with beef, beans and cheddar and fold tight.
Fry at 180C until crisp.
Serve with sour cream, guacamole and salsa.

note: Chicken thighs baked with 40 whole garlic cloves, thyme and white wine

steps.text: Brown the chicken skin side down in oil
Add the garlic, thyme and wine
Cover and bake at 180C
Squeeze the soft garlic onto slices of crusty bread and eat with the chicken

film: Indiana Jones and the Dial of Destiny (2023)
note: Chicken thighs simmered with saffron, preserved lemon and green olives, over couscous

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Brown the chicken in the oil.
Soften the onion with the ginger and saffron. Add the water, preserved lemon and olives.
Cover and simmer until tender.
Steep the couscous in hot water, fluff with a fork and serve under the tagine.

note: Duck dried overnight, rubbed with five spice and salt, then roasted and glazed

dish.make_ahead: Dry the duck in the fridge overnight

steps.text: The night before, prick the duck all over and leave uncovered in the fridge to dry.
Rub inside the cavity with five spice and salt.
Roast at 180C.
Glaze with honey and soy and roast for the last stretch.
Rest the duck, then carve.
Slice the cucumber and spring onions. Serve with pancakes and hoisin.

note: Saffron risotto finished with butter and parmesan

steps.text: Soften the diced onion in some of the butter.
Add the rice and toast, then add the wine.
Add the hot stock ladle by ladle, with the saffron steeped in, stirring.
Finish with the rest of the butter and the parmesan.

note: shredded beef with capsicum, rice and black beans

dish.make_ahead: Beef up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled in its broth

steps.text: Simmer the steak with the bay leaves and half an onion in water until tender. Shred it and keep 250ml of the broth.
Fry the sliced onion, capsicums and garlic in olive oil until soft.
Add the cumin, oregano, tomatoes, olives, beef and broth and simmer.
Cook the rice and warm the black beans, and serve alongside.

note: the cabbies' table at 3am

dish.make_ahead: Best eaten straight away

steps.text: Peel and boil the potatoes until soft, then mash with the butter.
Cook the peas and toss with butter.
Warm the beef in the hot gravy.
Toast the bread, lay on plates, pile on the beef and pour over more gravy. Serve with the mash and peas.

note: Grilled chicken thighs in an allspice, thyme, chilli and lime paste, with rice

steps.text: Blitz the allspice, thyme, chilli, lime juice and spring onion into a paste.
Marinate the chicken in the paste.
Cook the rice with the drained kidney beans.
Grill the chicken until charred and cooked through.

film: To All the Boys I've Loved Before (2018)
note: Soy, pear and garlic beef seared hot, jasmine rice, quick cucumber kimchi

dish.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day, sear fresh

steps.text: Slice the beef thin and marinate in soy, grated pear, crushed garlic and sesame oil for an hour.
Cook the rice.
Toss sliced cucumbers with salt, chilli and vinegar as a quick kimchi.
Sear the beef hot in batches.
Serve with the rice and cucumbers.

note: gravy and meatballs at the neighbourhood boss's table

dish.make_ahead: Sauce up to 1 day ahead, better the next day

steps.text: Mix the mince with egg, breadcrumbs, salt and pepper and shape into 12 meatballs.
Brown the meatballs and ribs in olive oil in a heavy pot, turning, then set aside.
Soften the onion, add the garlic, then the tomatoes, water and basil.
Return the meat, cover partly and simmer gently, stirring and adding water if needed. Check the ribs are tender and the meatballs cooked through.
Boil the rigatoni, drain and toss with the sauce. Serve the meat on a platter.

note: Rib eyes and corn cobs off the coals, parsley chimichurri, potato salad

dish.n: Grilled rib eye with chimichurri and corn

steps.text: Blitz the parsley, oregano, garlic, chilli, vinegar and oil for the chimichurri.
Boil the potatoes until tender and drain.
Dress the potatoes with mayonnaise and sliced spring onion.
Grill the rib eyes and corn over hot coals.
Rest the steaks briefly and serve with chimichurri.

note: Jerk marinated chicken grilled until charred, rice and kidney beans

dish.make_ahead: Marinate a day ahead

steps.text: Blitz the chillies, allspice, thyme, spring onions, garlic and lime juice into a paste and coat the chicken.
Marinate in the fridge overnight.
Grill slowly over coals until charred and cooked through.
Cook the rice with the drained kidney beans and coconut milk.

note: Pork shoulder slow cooked in banana leaves with smoked salt, over jasmine rice

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, shred and reheat covered

steps.text: Rub the pork with smoked salt.
Wrap tightly in banana leaves, then foil.
Cook at 150C until it falls apart.
While the pork rests, cook the jasmine rice and shred the cabbage with lime juice and sesame oil.
Shred the pork and serve over rice with the cabbage salad.

note: Thin pepperoni and mozzarella pizza baked hot and cut in squares

steps.text: Stretch the dough into 2 thin bases.
Spread with sauce, then add mozzarella, pepperoni and oregano.
Bake on a hot steel at maximum heat.
Cut into squares and leave in the box on the bench.

note: the famous spaghetti dinner behind Tony's

dish.make_ahead: Sauce and meatballs up to 2 days ahead

ingredients.item: parmesan, grated, plus extra to serve

steps.text: Mix both minces with the parmesan, parsley and egg and roll into balls.
Brown the meatballs in the oil in batches.
Add the tomatoes and basil and simmer gently until the sauce is thick and the balls are cooked through.
Cook the spaghetti until al dente and pile on one big plate with the sauce. Leave the last meatball for your date.

note: Grilled rump with parsley chimichurri, corn, sausages and apple slaw

steps.text: Blitz the parsley, garlic, oregano, chilli, vinegar and oil into chimichurri.
Grill the corn, turning.
Grill the sausages.
Season the steak and grill over high heat, then rest and slice.
Toss the cabbage and apple with the mayonnaise and lemon juice.
Spoon the chimichurri over the steak and serve with corn, sausages and slaw.

note: Two smashed beef patties, cheese and pickle sauce, with paprika fries

steps.text: Bake the frozen fries at 220C for 25 minutes and toss with salt and paprika.
Roll the beef mince into balls.
Smash flat on a very hot plate, season and cook 2 minutes, flip, add cheese and cook 1 minute.
Mix the mayo, the tomato sauce, the mustard and chopped pickles.
Toast the buns, spread with sauce and stack the patties with diced onion and pickles.

note: Glazed beef meatloaf baked in a loaf tin

steps.text: Mix the mince with the grated onion, egg, breadcrumbs, Worcestershire and salt. Press into a lined loaf tin.
Spread with the tomato sauce mixed with the sugar and bake at 180C.
Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with some of the butter and the milk.
Fry the sliced onions in butter, stir in the flour, then the stock, and simmer to a gravy.
Cook the peas and serve everything together.

note: Beef and pork meatloaf with tomato glaze, mashed potato and peas

dish.make_ahead: Loaf up to 1 day, keep chilled and reheat

steps.text: Soak the breadcrumbs in the milk, then mix lightly with both minces, onion, egg and Worcestershire.
Shape in a loaf tin, glaze with tomato sauce and bake at 180C.
Boil the potatoes and mash with the butter. Cook the peas.
Rest the loaf, slice and serve with mash and peas.

note: Eggs, bacon, sausages, hash browns, mushrooms and tomato with toast

steps.text: Bake the hash browns at 220C until crisp.
Fry the sausages over medium heat.
Fry the bacon until crisp, keeping the fat in the pan.
Fry the tomatoes cut-side down. Fry the mushrooms in some of the butter with the garlic.
Fry the eggs in the bacon fat.
Toast the bread and butter it well. Load up plates and serve with tomato sauce.

note: Buttermilk pancakes with crisp bacon and fried eggs on one plate

steps.text: Whisk the flour, baking powder, two eggs and buttermilk into a batter.
Cook the pancakes in butter and keep warm.
Fry the bacon.
Fry the four remaining eggs.
Pile it all on a big plate and pour over maple syrup.

note: Stir fried chicken thigh and red capsicum with egg noodles in sweet chilli and soy

steps.text: Cook the noodles and drain.
Stir-fry the chicken in a hot wok until browned.
Add the capsicum and cook briefly.
Toss through the noodles with sweet chilli and soy sauce until sticky and pack into takeaway boxes.

note: Two smashed beef patties with American cheese and special sauce

dish.make_ahead: Best fresh

steps.text: Roll the mince into 8 balls. Mix the mayonnaise with tomato sauce.
Smash each flat on a smoking griddle, season and cook, then flip and add cheese.
Stack 2 per toasted bun with pickles, diced onion and sauce.

note: Cheddar cheeseburger on a sesame bun with lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles and fries

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into fries and dry well
Shape the mince into patties and salt them
Fry the fries once at a lower heat, then again at a higher heat until golden. Salt well
Grill the patties to medium and melt the cheddar on top
Toast the buns and build with lettuce, tomato, onion and pickles

note: Pan seared chicken in a lemon, caper and white wine sauce

steps.text: Pound the chicken thin, cut in half, then flour.
Boil the pasta until tender and drain.
Sear the chicken in oil until golden and cooked through.
Add the wine, lemon juice and capers and reduce.
Whisk in the butter. Toss the pasta through and serve the chicken on top.

note: Beef chuck braised with juniper, blackcurrant jam and carrots, over mashed potatoes

dish.n: Klaus's juniper beef stew with mash
dish.make_ahead: Stew better the next day

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches.
Slice the onions and chop the carrots, then cook with the beef.
Stir in the flour, juniper, thyme, jam and stock.
Cover and simmer until the beef falls apart.
Boil the potatoes and mash with butter and milk.
Serve the stew over the mash.

note: Silky ginger rice porridge topped with fried egg and bacon

steps.text: Simmer the rice in the stock with the ginger for 90 minutes, stirring often, until silky.
Fry the eggs and bacon.
Top each bowl with an egg and bacon smile, spring onion and soy.

note: Smashed cheeseburgers with pickle special sauce on toasted buns

dish.make_ahead: Sauce up to 2 days, cook fresh

steps.text: Toss the fries in oil and bake at 220C, turning once, until golden.
Mix the mayonnaise with the chopped pickles for the special sauce. Roll the mince into 4 balls.
Smash the balls flat on a very hot pan. Season, flip after 2 minutes and add the cheese.
Build on toasted buns with onion, pickles and sauce. Serve with the fries.

film: Star Wars: Episode I - The Phantom Menace (1999)
note: Harissa chicken thighs roasted over chickpeas and onions, flatbread, cucumber yogurt

dish.make_ahead: Make fresh

steps.text: Rub the chicken with harissa, lemon juice and salt.
Spread the chickpeas and onions in a tray and sit the chicken on top.
Roast at 200C for 40 minutes.
Mix the cucumber into the yoghurt. Warm the flatbreads and serve everything together.

note: Sirloin roast, potatoes, Yorkshire puddings and red wine gravy

dish.make_ahead: Rest 20 minutes before carving

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Season the beef and roast until 52C inside.
Rest the beef under foil.
Roast the potatoes in oil.
Whisk the eggs, flour and milk and bake in hot oiled tins at 220C.
Reduce the red wine with the pan juices for gravy.

note: shaved, dipped and hot

dish.make_ahead: Roast and chill up to 1 day ahead; shave and warm to serve

ingredients.item: dried oregano, plus 1 tsp for the jus
black pepper, plus more for the jus

steps.text: Rub the beef with salt, pepper and oregano and roast at 200C to 52C inside.
Chill the beef well, then shave it thin.
Simmer the stock with the garlic, oregano and plenty of pepper.
Warm the beef in the jus, pile into the rolls, dip the whole sandwich and top with giardiniera.

note: Beef chuck, carrots and parsnips simmered 3 hours in tomato beef stock

dish.n: Crossroads tavern beef and root veg stew
dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Brown the beef in the oil in batches.
Add the onion, carrots and parsnips and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the flour and tomato paste, then the stock, thyme and bay leaf.
Cover and simmer for 3 hours until the beef is tender and the sauce is rich.
Serve in bowls with crusty bread and butter.

note: White fish with lime and garlic, mango chilli salsa, jasmine rice

dish.n: Lime grilled fish with mango salsa

steps.text: Rub the fish with lime juice, crushed garlic and salt.
Dice the mango, chilli and red onion and mix with lime juice for salsa.
Cook the rice in the coconut milk with a pinch of salt and a splash of water.
Grill the fish until just cooked.
Serve the fish on the rice with the salsa.

note: Beef patties with melted cheddar, bacon and fried onion, crinkle chips

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into crinkle chips.
Fry the chips twice until crisp.
Shape the mince into patties and season.
Grill the patties, melting cheddar on top at the end.
Fry the bacon and onion until golden.
Toast the buns.
Stack it all in the buns and serve with the chips.

note: Lime and cumin marinated skirt steak, sliced thin, with rice and black beans

dish.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Mix lime juice, a little orange juice, crushed garlic and cumin, then add the steak.
Marinate the steak at room temperature for 2 hours.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, and warm the beans in a small pot.
Sear the steak over very high heat for 3 minutes a side, char the spring onions in the same pan.
Rest the steak, then slice thin against the grain.
Serve with the rice, beans and spring onions.

note: White fish and prawns in creamy sauce under a mashed potato top

steps.text: Poach the white fish in the milk for 5 minutes and flake.
Make a sauce with the butter, the flour and the poaching milk, add the peeled prawns and chopped parsley, and pour into a dish with the fish.
Top with the potatoes mashed with the butter and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

note: Beef, mushroom, corn and green bean casserole under crisp potato gems

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, bake fresh with the tots on top

steps.text: Brown the mince with the onion in the oil. Add the mushrooms and cook until their liquid has gone.
Stir in the corn, beans and cream and simmer briefly. Spread in a baking dish.
Cover with neat rows of potato gems and bake at 200C until golden.

note: put the record on and let it simmer low

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days ahead, better the next day

steps.text: Brown the lamb in batches in oil.
Layer in a heavy pot with the onions, carrots and potatoes.
Pour over the stout and stock, cover and braise at 160C for 2 hours until tender.
Finish with parsley.

note: Smoked paprika rump steaks grilled hard, with garlic parsley chili sauce

dish.make_ahead: Chimichurri up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Rub the steaks with salt, pepper and smoked paprika.
Chop the parsley and garlic and mix with the vinegar, oil and chilli flakes.
Grill over high heat, turning once.
Rest the steaks, then spoon over the chimichurri.

film: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs (1937)
note: Chicken thighs, leeks and potatoes simmered with thyme

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Soften the leeks in the butter.
Add the chicken, potatoes, thyme, water and salt.
Simmer until the potatoes break down.
Stir in the cream and serve in big bowls with torn bread.

note: Beer-battered flathead fillets with thick double-fried chips

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chips and fry at 150C for 6 minutes, then 190C for 3 minutes.
Whisk the flour with the cold lager into a batter, dip the flathead fillets and fry at 180C for 4 minutes.
Mix the mayonnaise with chopped pickles for tartare and serve with lemon.
Cut the potatoes into chips.
Fry the chips once at a lower heat and drain.
Reduce the vinegar with the tarragon until a couple of tablespoons remain.
Whisk the reduction with the yolks over low heat and drizzle in the warm clarified butter.
Sear the rib eyes, then baste with butter, thyme and garlic.
Rest the steaks and fry the chips again until crisp.
Serve the steaks with the sauce and chips.

note: Chicken thigh, carrot, celery and peas in a creamy sauce under puff pastry

dish.make_ahead: Filling up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Brown the chicken, then add the diced onion, carrots, celery and thyme.
Stir in the flour, then the stock and cream, and simmer until thick.
Add the peas and tip into a pie dish.
Cover with puff pastry and brush with egg.
Bake at 200C.

film: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy (2004)
note: Stay classy, San Diego. Mild chicken tacos for the news team.

dish.make_ahead: Crema and salsa up to 4 hours ahead

steps.text: Cut the chicken into strips and coat in the flour mixed with paprika and cumin, then egg, then panko.
Arrange on a lined tray, drizzle with oil and bake at 220C, turning halfway, until golden and the thickest piece reaches 75C.
Mix the sour cream with the juice of one lime for the crema, and toss the tomato and onion with the juice of the other lime.
Warm the tortillas as the packet says and fill with chicken, cabbage, salsa and crema. Keep any chilli on the side.

note: Leeks softened in butter, simmered with potato and chicken stock

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep the soup chilled and the toppings fresh

ingredients.item: thickened cream, plus a little extra to swirl
salt and white pepper, to taste

steps.text: Slice the leeks, keeping a few green tops aside, and dice the potatoes.
Soften the leeks and potatoes in the butter without browning.
Add the stock and simmer until the potato is very soft.
Blend until smooth, stir in the cream and season with salt and white pepper.
Fry thin strips of the green leek tops in hot oil until crisp, and blitz the chives with the olive oil.
Serve the soup with a swirl of cream, the chive oil, crispy leeks and buttered crusty bread.

film: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness (2022)
note: Braised pork belly, miso broth, ramen noodles and soft boiled eggs

steps.text: Braise the pork belly in soy and water until tender, then slice.
Simmer the pork.
Soft-boil the eggs, cool and halve.
Heat the stock and whisk in the miso.
Cook the noodles and build each bowl differently with pork, eggs, corn and nori.

note: Lamb leg studded with garlic, rosemary and anchovy, with tomato chickpeas

steps.text: Stud the lamb with garlic, rosemary and anchovies.
Roast at 180C until 58C inside, about 90 minutes.
Rest the lamb for 20 minutes. Meanwhile simmer the chickpeas with the tomatoes, then stir through the spinach.
Carve and serve with the chickpeas.

note: Whole chicken with garlic thyme butter, roasted over potatoes

dish.make_ahead: Best fresh

steps.text: Mix the butter with crushed garlic, thyme and salt and rub over the chicken.
Cut the potatoes into chunks and set a rack over them in a roasting tin.
Roast at 200C, turning the potatoes halfway, until the juices run clear.
Rest, then carve.

note: Glazed grilled chicken thighs over jasmine rice with stir-fried broccoli

dish.n: Eden Prairie food court teriyaki chicken
dish.make_ahead: Glaze up to 3 days ahead

steps.text: Simmer the soy sauce, mirin, sugar and ginger until syrupy.
Steam the rice. Grill the chicken, brushing with the glaze, until sticky and charred.
Stir-fry the broccoli quickly. Slice the chicken over the rice and spoon over the extra sauce.

note: Beef chuck stewed with onion, carrot, allspice and molasses

dish.n: Captain Hook's beef and allspice stew
dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Toss the beef in the flour. Slice the onions and chop the carrots.
Brown the beef in batches in a heavy pot.
Soften the onions and carrots.
Return the beef and add the allspice, molasses, tomato paste and stock.
Cover and simmer gently until thick and tender.
Season well and serve in big bowls with crusty bread.

note: Smashed onion beef patties with American cheese, pickles and mustard

steps.text: Roll the mince into eight balls and slice the onion very thinly.
Heat a griddle until very hot. Put a few onion slices on each ball and smash flat, onion side down.
Flip after 90 seconds, add a slice of cheese and cook briefly.
Toast the buns.
Stack two patties per bun with pickles and mustard.

note: Herb butter roast turkey breast with cornbread stuffing

dish.n: Tuohy Thanksgiving turkey at the table
dish.make_ahead: Gravy and sides up to 1 day ahead, roast the turkey fresh

steps.text: Push the herb butter under the skin of the turkey breast.
Roast at 180C until cooked through, then rest.
Crumble the cornbread with the fried onion, celery, chopped sage, egg and stock.
Bake the stuffing until golden.
Peel and chop the potatoes.
Boil the potatoes until tender and mash with butter and milk.
Blanch the green beans and toss in butter.
Make gravy from the pan juices with flour and stock.
Serve with cranberry sauce.

note: Seared sirloin, thin fries and tarragon bearnaise sauce

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thin fries.
Fry twice until crisp.
Sear the steaks.
Rest the steaks.
Reduce the vinegar with the tarragon.
Whisk in the egg yolks over gentle heat.
Slowly add the melted butter, whisking.
Serve the steak over the fries.

note: Stir fried chicken thigh, red capsicum, broccoli and egg noodles

steps.text: Slice the capsicum and cut the broccoli into florets.
Cook the noodles and drain.
Stir-fry the chicken in a hot wok until browned.
Add the capsicum and broccoli and cook.
Toss in the noodles with soy and honey until sticky and glossy.
